map.不准。低温、浸泡、发热疾病、衣着厚重会显著改变冷却曲线，Henssge 法已做校: Not accurate. Low temperature, immersion, febrile illness and heavy clothing all change the cooling curve markedly; the Henssge method corrects for this but is still an approximation and must be combined with lividity, rigor mortis and stomach contents.
map.单指标误差大（尸温受环境波动、角膜受个体差异），多指标（尸温+尸斑+尸僵+胃内容: A single indicator carries large error (body temperature fluctuates with the environment, corneal opacity varies between individuals); converging multiple indicators (body temperature + lividity + rigor + stomach contents + entomology) is what improves inference reliability.
